semantic_atoms.observed: FrankEye unifies Digital Retina v8 CNN classification, DINOv2 scene analysis, GOLPU feature extraction, Tesseract OCR, OpenCV face detection and hand-crafted HOG/color/spatial/texture features into a CPU-only vision pipeline.

The inspected module resolves Retina weights, GOLPU library and DINO ONNX/config from concrete host paths and lazy-loads dependencies. These paths are environment bindings, not portable artifact attestations by themselves.

The public analyze(image_path, deep=False) interface ultimately returns a natural-language description, optionally enriched by deeper GoL analysis, rather than a typed causal perception packet as its primary API result.

semantic_atoms.source_span: FrankEye output contract versus current Typed Entry/evidence law
semantic_atoms.observed: A natural-language image description collapses multiple detector/model outputs and can lose exact uncertainty, bounding geometry, model identity, source image identity and disagreements. It cannot serve as canonical observation evidence by itself.

preserve: explicit feature extraction useful for downstream causal conditioning
change: Admit each image/frame through Typed Entry with causal_event_id, admission_id, observed/received times, source device/path identity, frame sequence/generation and raw payload digest before cognition.

Emit a structured VisualObservation containing detector/model artifact identities, feature vectors or typed summaries, OCR spans, face/object detections, confidence/uncertainty and per-detector provenance.
Keep raw image/frame reference or digest-addressed evidence according to retention policy so natural-language descriptions can be audited or regenerated.
Natural-language scene description is a DerivedPerceptionNarrative projection for GRID/GWT context, never the sole observation record.
Preserve detector disagreement instead of smoothing it into one description; unresolved visual alternatives enter Hyperposition/candidate space.
Any behavior triggered by visual inference still yields ActionCandidate and requires EffectGate/EffectJournal for effects; verified consequences return as new Typed Entry observations.
architecture_delta_for_frankenstein_2.recommended_flow: image/frame -> Typed Entry -> VisualObservation multi-detector packet -> DerivedPerceptionNarrative/feature projection -> CausalWorkspaceFrame -> GRID/GWT/HCU -> ActionCandidate -> EffectGate -> EffectJournal -> outcome re-entry

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Keeping structured detector outputs plus raw-frame digest will improve auditability and causal learning compared with storing only the generated scene narrative.
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: A replay/audit benchmark shows the natural-language description alone recovers all detector confidence, disagreement, spatial identity, model identity and source-frame provenance needed for every downstream decision.

triggerword4_handoff.instruction: Port FrankEye as a Visual Cortex donor behind Typed Entry. Freeze image/frame and model identities, keep structured detector outputs, then derive language for workspace context. Never use the language description as the sole visual evidence.

next_frontier: Voice/presence input-output causal binding and verified outcome re-entry; if no high-value exact source is discoverable, move to UnifiedDB defect convergence and GWT/workspace integration.
